[[Category: Beltonanean Townland, Kildress Parish, County Tyrone]]
== Biography ==
David was born about 1833. He is the son of [[Glasgow-585|William Glasgow]] and [[Henry-6408|Mary Henry]]. 

He was living in Beltonanean as of 1878.
<ref name="m"/>

On 17 Oct 1878 at Oritor Presbyterian, Kildress, he married Margaret Jane Glasgow of Ballynasollus, daughter of James Glasgow, farmer.
<ref name="m">[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/f3cb5e2636703 David Glasgow, Margaret Glasgow, 1878, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

In 1901 David Glasgow’s family were living in Beltonanean. David 64,  and his wife Margaret J. 46, and their children, William J. 21, Gilbert J. 20, Samuel H. 18, Leslie 17, Lewis 13, Miriam 11, Robert 9, Joseph C. 7, Martha Emily 5 Thomas H 4, and Jane Glasgow sister 74 not married.<ref> http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1901/Tyrone/Ballynasollus/Beltonanean/1730454/ </ref>
A marriage for David Glasgow and Margaret Glasgow was registered on 17 October 1878 in the Cookstown district.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/marriage GRONI civil marriage index], 17 October 1878, Cookstown district, M/1878/L1/1132/2/14.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-585]] is assessed at 96% (proved). David’s supported sister Jane is named as William’s daughter in the Montober will, and his 1901 household explicitly calls Jane his sister. His role in William’s will and death context reinforces this father through the actual sibling family, despite an informant-residence discrepancy.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect David’s 1878 marriage father field against William’s will/death informant.

Source basis already held: [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1901/Tyrone/Ballynasollus/Beltonanean/1730454/ 1901 Ireland census (http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1901/Tyrone/Ballynasollus/Beltonanean/1730454/) - Residents of a house 13 in Beltonanean (Ballynasollus, Tyrone). David(64), Margaret J(46), William J(21), Gilbert J(20), Samuel H(18), Leslie(17), Lewis(13), Miriam(11), Robert(9), Joseph C(7), Martha Emily(5), Thomas H(4), Jane Glasgow(74, sister). All Methodist.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
